archetypes.name: dyn-probe-cache
archetypes.rationale: Review model-and-auth keyed probe stamp and gate-detail lifecycle behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the Codex Step 0 probe cache and paired gate-detail handoff. Verify healthy, unrelated, expired, malformed, and identity-mismatched results cannot surface stale upgrade advice. Check the TTL-zero immediate handoff separately from normal negative caching. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
